remarks: Light and bright remodeled First Floor Apartment in the heart of South End! Two minutes walk to Stamford RR for a quick train ride into Manhattan.  Spacious first-floor unit (#1) with high ceilings and plenty of natural light.  Generous living room with bay windows.  Galley style kitchen with gas range, efficiently designed.  Full bath with a shower and window for ventilation!  Oversized primary bedroom with abundance of windows and new blinds.  Bonus: Private access to a front porch where you can put a table and chairs and while away those balmy evenings watching the world go by.  Extras: Coin-operated washer and dryer in the shared lower level, along with additional storage space.  One dedicated parking spot in the driveway behind the house.  Tenants to pay $200 a month to cover utilities - heat, hot water, cooking gas, and electricity (light and a/c units). Landlord is looking for strong credit and stable work history (2.5 times monthly rent in income). Maximum two inhabitants, no pets!   Schedule your tour today!
